question.text: Under the Gordon Growth Model, P0 = D1/(r - g). If D1 = Rs. 10, r = 12%, g = 7%, intrinsic value is:

explanation.text: The Logic: P0 = 10 / (0.12 - 0.07) = 10 / 0.05 = Rs. 200. The Trap: Other values reflect arithmetic errors. Cross-Exam Context: Core DDM calc in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Ensure (r - g) is positive and reasonable; near-zero denominators blow up the model.
